metadata.pr_title: Add nodes for basic string operations
metadata.pr_description:
String nodes, requested in RFC https://github.com/Kosinkadink/rfcs/blob/main/rfcs/0000-corenodes.md#string-nodes
Designed nodes:
1. Concatenate, and input is: 
- string_a, 
- string_b 
- separator
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/894c0afc-664f-49a2-a0de-ed60c2aacfc5)
2. Substring, and input is:
- string
- start
- end
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1ab814a6-f360-43cb-86be-ac61486c9a78)

3. Length, and input is
- string
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/eb4f7413-2f59-4faf-aaa7-cc3b0fbf4322)

4. Case Converter, and input is
- string
- mode, with options are ["UPPERCASE", "lowercase", "Capitalize", "Title Case"]
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ba1041fd-40f5-4af0-a52b-c0df3ae3d3e4)

5. Trim, and input is
- string
- mode, with options are ["BOTH", "LEFT", "RIGHT"]
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6489d7d8-ab78-4e9e-b172-b4f7e3cbacb2)

6. Replace, and input is
- string
- find
- replace
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/997c09d6-75f2-4e71-90d5-6d0f77cfcb09)

7. Contains, and input is
- string
- substring
- case_sensitive
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e66adb5b-02de-4ba8-b848-f9f83215e694)

8. Compare, and input is
- string_a
- string_b
- mode, with options are ["StartsWith", "EndsWith", "Equal"]
- case_sensitive
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4dd3b9ae-f3d8-41bc-90c2-8e459a923840)

9. Regex Match, and input is
- string
- regex_pattern
- case_insensitive
- multiline
- dotall
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a57ea778-009b-4b8e-94d0-e440c6ca235d)

10. Regex Extract, and input is
- string
- regex_pattern
- mode, with options are ["First Match", "All Matches", "First Group", "All Groups"]
- case_insensitive
- multiline
- dotall
- group_index
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b4d1fce8-f2a9-422d-8b62-9ac90d50060a)

review_planner.summary: The changes introduce a new file `comfy_extras/nodes_string.py` with various string manipulation classes and update `nodes.py` to include this new file in the list of extra nodes.

tasks.title: Security Review
tasks.description: Verify that there are no security vulnerabilities in the new string manipulation classes. Pay special attention to the `RegexMatch` and `RegexExtract` methods which involve regex operations, as they can be exploited with malicious input patterns.

tasks.title: Logic Review
tasks.description: Check the logic of all methods in `comfy_extras/nodes_string.py` to ensure they behave as expected. Validate the handling of different cases, especially in `CaseConverter`, `StringTrim`, `StringContains`, and `StringCompare`. Ensure that default values and optional parameters are handled correctly.

tasks.title: Performance Review
tasks.description: Assess the performance implications of the new string manipulation classes. Consider the efficiency of methods like `StringReplace`, `RegexMatch`, and `RegexExtract` with large strings or complex regex patterns. Ensure that the methods handle edge cases without significant performance degradation.

tasks.title: General Review
tasks.description: Perform a general review of `comfy_extras/nodes_string.py` to check for consistency with existing code, adherence to coding standards, and completeness of documentation. Verify that all classes and methods have appropriate docstrings and comments. Also, check that the new file is correctly added to `nodes.py`.
